{"summary": "I fixed `median()` in `src/stats.js`. It had two bugs:

- **Wrong sort order:** `.sort()` with no comparator sorts values as text, so `[10, 9, 2]` came out as `[10, 2, 9]`. It now sorts by numeric value with `(a, b) => a - b`.
- **Even-length lists:** it returned the upper of the two middle values. It now returns their average, so `[4, 1, 3, 2]` gives `2.5`.

I also made an empty list return `NaN`; before, it returned `undefined`. I added tests for all three cases to `test/stats.test.js`, and `npm test` passes all 4 tests."}
